title: TMITR 909
line_text: But what you see in it can always change

line_text: Much like how the dirt, the water, the minerals on this earth will exist whether you decide to look at it or not

line_text: But the way that you choose to see it can always change

line_text: If you view the world as a dangerous place that can only hurt you then you may learn to fear it

line_text: If you view the world as something endless for you to explore then you may learn to be curious

title: TMITR 909
line_text: The way it's viewed is dependent upon the viewer

line_text: You have the ability to control yourself
